run_metadata.coverage_summary: Degraded run - outbound HTTPS via WebFetch was entirely blocked by the environment network egress policy (blanket block confirmed: even example.com and www.tenders.gov.au returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, and the agent proxy status endpoint reported no relay failures - this is an organization-level egress restriction, not a per-site fault, and per /root/.ccr/README.md such policy denials must be reported, not routed around). Only the WebSearch tool was functional. WebSearch surfaced genuine, currently-relevant opportunities across Tier 1 (NT QTOL, ACT Tenders, NSW eTendering incl. a council on VendorPanel, Transport for NSW, QLD TMR) and Tier 2 (Greater Western Water GBE, Sydney Water), captured here at HEADLINE level only from result snippets. Because no tender detail page or document could be opened, tender IDs, exact closing times, deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, values and contacts are UNVERIFIED and left null/empty - every tender entry is flagged in its notes and counted in entries_pending_detail. Tier 3 (SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, EstimateOne) was checked and is entirely login/registration-gated: no publicly-visible corporate RFx was found, so no corporate tenders were invented; the portals are recorded in discovered_sources with access_method=portal-registration. Source discovery still ran and found six new buyer-originated sources.
gaps: WebFetch / outbound HTTPS is entirely blocked by the environment egress policy (EGRESS_BLOCKED on every host tested, including example.com and www.tenders.gov.au). No tender detail page or specification document could be opened this run, so all detail/deliverables/requirements/value/contact fields are null and every tender is headline-level only.

Tier 1 core portals (AusTender, Tenders VIC, QTenders/supply.qld.gov.au, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders TAS) could only be searched, not fetched - concrete open-tender rows for VIC, QLD (QTenders), WA, SA and TAS were not retrievable at row level via WebSearch snippets this run and are deferred to a future run when egress is available.

Tier 3 corporate e-sourcing hubs (SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP Find Opportunities, Rio Tinto Buy Local, Fortescue Supplier Centre, EstimateOne) are registration- or login-gated; no publicly-visible RFx detail was accessible. Portals recorded in discovered_sources; no corporate opportunities fabricated.

Invitation-only management-consultancy and panel RFPs (e.g. DFAT Development Procurement Pipeline RFTs released only to shortlisted organisations, closing 19 Aug 2026) are out of scope - not publicly discoverable and not recorded as tenders.

A surgical-supplies health tender (closing 26 Aug 2026 14:00 AEST) surfaced only via a paid aggregator with no clear buyer-originated source; per the buyer-originated rule it was treated as a discovery signal only and NOT recorded as a confirmed tender because the buying organisation and its own source could not be identified.
QLD TMR RSSP ICT Managed Services EOI closed 23 Aug 2026 (before this run date); included for provenance but likely now closed.
